meta.name: noslip-phase r4 — anchored no-slip walk (obs 74)
meta.notes: RL-polished clamp-fit no-slip gait (cw-arch-noslipphase1-r4, gate PASS 08-13: return 943, loadslip 0.54mm, progress 0.71). obs 74 = walk + phase clock; runner keeps the clock (phase_hz in meta). Slow by design: 0.008-0.016 m/s band, 6 s cycle, quasi-static — command LOW speeds. All headings trained, runs naked (no rot-60). NEVER bench-tested; first hardware try = short leash, hand on X.
